newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC board to meet Nov 26, results.
newsitem.headline: India ACC board to meet Nov 26, results.

text.p: Associated Cement Companies Ltd (ACC) has called a meeting of its board on November 26 to finalise results for the six months to September 30, 1996, the firm said in a notice to the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday.
The firm, India's largest cement firm, made a net profit of 1.25 billion rupees on sales of 11.16 billion in the year-ago period.

A Reuter poll of 14 leading securities firms in September forecast the average net profit to fall 6.1 percent to 1.17 billion rupees in the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) on sales of 11.60 billion rupees.
